name: 23510 · Norfolk, VA
findings: ZIP 23510 (Norfolk) has 170 nonprofit organizations. 68 of them (40%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 56 organizations.
Economic development organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (16% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 23510 (Norfolk) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.
34% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.
